state.project: Miu World: a voxel learning game for Vietnamese grade-2 children (web, iPad Gen 10), built 100% by AI. The owner's single wish: truly lively so children never get bored. Textbook (SGK) wording must stay verbatim; story text around it is free but every line must be fresh (no repeats).
state.owner_feedback: Owner, relaying their child: 'one NPC holds at most 2 quests; make more scenarios and more quest NPCs in each map. The child complains about standing in one place to do the quest too much.'
facts: 71 quests (35 forest, 36 school), 17-19 steps each, 614 challenge steps. Each step is hosted by an NPC or a thing placed on the map by data.

School: on average 9 of 17 steps happen at the quest giver; the longest run of consecutive steps at one spot averages 7.3 (one quest does all 17 at one spot). Forest: 4.9 distinct characters per quest, longest run averages 5.3, max 11.
16 characters give 3-4 quests each; 23 characters appear (in any role) in more than 2 quests, e.g. the guide parrot Vẹt Xanh in 11.

Appearances available: 45 NPC looks (24 animals, 18 people, 3 calves) plus a character library that builds chibi characters from parts and shared outfits (4 species built so far; more can be assembled from data). Meeting the cap with about 4 NPCs per quest needs roughly 140 characters.
Placement and checks are data-driven: new characters are entries in a data file, placed in the quest's zone by a placer; a content check can enforce rules so they never regress.

cap_scope.instructions: What does 'one NPC holds at most 2 quests' cap?

criteria.any_role: A character appears as a quest NPC (giver or any step host) in at most 2 quests in total; things (signs, boards, objects) are not NPCs and are not capped.
criteria.giver_only: A character gives at most 2 quests; it may still host steps in any number of other quests.

spread_rule.instructions: How strictly should a quest's steps be spread over places so the child keeps moving?

criteria.two_in_a_row_four_places: At most 2 consecutive steps at the same place, and each quest visits at least 4 different places (NPCs or things), checked by content:check.
criteria.three_in_a_row_three_places: At most 3 consecutive steps at the same place, and each quest visits at least 3 different places.

new_npc_looks.instructions: How should the ~140 quest characters get their appearance?

criteria.looks_plus_chibi_library: Use the 45 existing NPC looks with distinct names, and also assemble new chibi characters from the character library (species, colours, outfits) so neighbours rarely look alike.
criteria.existing_looks_only: Reuse only the 45 existing looks under different names.

guide_exempt.instructions: Should the forest's guide parrot (Vẹt Xanh, a companion who guides the child in 11 quests) be exempt from the 2-quest cap?

criteria.exempt_one_guide: Yes: one guide per map may appear in any number of quests as a guide; every other character is capped.
criteria.cap_guide_too: No: the guide is capped at 2 quests like every other character; other characters take over guiding.
